about: Bracket text objects. Vim's rule (src/textobject.c:current_block): if the cursor is on the opener, use it; otherwise search BACKWARDS for an unclosed opener, and if there is none, search FORWARDS for the next opener, then match its closer. The cursor does NOT have to be inside. nvi and busybox have no text objects at all, so these are vim-only comparisons.
